Plans written by the planner in live runs, kept as test fixtures.

- `shop_analytics.json`: "a sales analytics dashboard for a small online shop" (PC-050).
- `hiring_portal.json`: the shop plan extended by hand with attachment fields (PC-102): customers with a
  resume and a photo, and products with several documents (PDFs and spreadsheets, 20 MB).
- `content_hub.json`: the minimal blog with rich-text fields (PC-104): a post's body (required) and
  summary (optional).
